name: Cooperation Jackson
description: A Jackson, Mississippi-based vehicle for building a solidarity economy anchored by worker-owned, democratically self-managed cooperatives. Working toward a federation of worker co-ops, a cooperative incubator, and a cooperative financial institution, plus an "Eco-Village" built on a community land trust that already holds dozens of parcels in West Jackson. Current cooperative ventures include an urban farm (Freedom Farms), a lawn-care co-op (The Green Team), and a small-scale digital fabrication co-op. A New Economy Coalition member organization.

notRepresentable: The Become a Member page says membership orientation meets on the 3rd Saturday of each month, "see calendar for details" — but the calendar has never listed an orientation, and no time or place is published anywhere, so there is nothing a reader could actually show up to. It is also aimed at Jackson and Mississippi residents (out-of-state supporters are pointed to Friends of Jackson chapters).
research.notes: Re-checked 2026-10-21 to backfill recurring events now that Event.recurrence exists, and none were added. The Build and Fight Formula Educational Series (second Tuesday monthly, 6pm CT, streamed on YouTube and social media) is still described on its January 2025 announcement page, but the last session on the calendar is #7 on 2025-08-12, and nothing has been listed since — listing it as ongoing would be a guess. The calendar's newest entry of any kind is Black August, 20-23 August 2025. The Really Really Free Market last appears on 2025-02-15. Worth re-checking if the calendar comes back to life. No Slack, Discord, or forum: only an email updates list, which doesn't meet the Forum bar.
